title: Martyrologium Romanum Gregorii XIII jussu editum, Urbani VIII et Clementis X auctoritate recognitum, ac deinde anno MDCCXLIX Benedicti XIV labore et studio auctum et castigatum
note: A 2013 retyping (Simon Heindl) of the Mechelen printing by Hubert Dessain, approved by Cardinal Mercier on 28 March 1913 and conformed to the edition issued under Leo XIII in 1902; it therefore includes eulogies added after 1749. Digitized from the PDF's text layer.
